title: pm-dispatch: unlock scan must distinguish "upstream merged" from "consumer can install" — release-gated cross-repo unblocks go pm:on-hold with a Restart-when, not back to queue
body:
pm-dispatch: the unlock scan cannot tell "upstream merged" from "consumer can install it" — a cross-repo unblock returned a card to work that no dispatch could run

## Authorization

Maintainer, verbatim (未译, in-session 2026-08-24): 「经验是不是应该写入项目 skills」 → 「写入」. This card carries the one lesson that touches the `SKILL.md` main file (协议语义面, clause ① ⇒ fable tier); the four `references/**` lessons are a sibling card.

## The gap, as lived

A hotcrm card sat `pm:blocked` on a platform card. The platform card closed (fix merged to objectstack main). By the state model as written, the unlock scan now returns the hotcrm card to `pm:queue` — but hotcrm consumes **published** `@objectstack/*` packages, and the merge was in no release. Any dispatch would have burned a full dev run to discover `premise_still_valid: false` ("the mechanism I need is not in my installed platform").

The seat improvised the correct handling: keep the card out of the queue as `pm:on-hold` with a machine-readable `Restart-when:` whose criterion is the **consumer's installed surface** (e.g. "installed spec accepts the new key"), not the producer's merge; record the already-shaped wake dispatch on the card so the next seat inherits it.

## What SKILL.md should say (self-contained, no issue ids, 中文 house style)

In the unlock-scan / `Blocked-by:` clause of the state model, add the boundary:

> **跨仓解锁的判据是「消费方可安装」，不是「上游已合并」。** `Blocked-by:` 指向的上游关卡时，若消费仓以**发布包**消费该上游（而非 git pin），解锁扫描先验证修复已进入消费方可安装的发行版（安装面探针：装的包是否接受新键/新行为）；未发版 ⇒ 转 `pm:on-hold` + `Restart-when: <消费方安装面判据>`，⛔ 不回 `pm:queue` —— 回队烧掉的派发注定以 premise-false 收场。发行与依赖升级是人工动作；hold 评论应预写唤醒后的派发形状，让任何座位可继承。以 git SHA pin 消费的仓不适用本条（pin 移动即可安装，走既有 pin 滞后读数）。

Fit the wording to the surrounding prose; the boundary sentence (pin-consuming repos excluded) is load-bearing — without it this clause would wrongly hold cards that the existing pin-lag reading already covers.

## Process

Draft PR only. This is a governed face: **maintainer merges manually** (2026-08-11 ruling: skills 更新与 ADR 同级人工审核). The PM's fable-tier review lands on this card before it reaches the maintainer.
